study: Nyhan & Reifler (2015), Displacing Misinformation about Events: An Experimental Test of Causal Corrections, Journal of Experimental Political Science
key_findings: Reproduced ALL six Table 2 OLS models exactly from author's replication dataset (causal-replication.dta) and Stata do-file (nyhan-reifler-causal-corrections.do).
Model 1 (IPW, favorability): den=-0.389, causal=0.075, innuendo=-0.584 (paper: -0.39, 0.08, -0.58); causal-innuendo diff=0.659 ~ paper 0.66.
Model 2 (survey, favorability): den=-0.410, innuendo=-0.523 (paper -0.41,-0.52); causal-innuendo diff=0.325, p=0.0435 ~ paper 0.32 p<.05.
Model 4 (survey, bribes): causal-denial = -0.358, p=0.0117 ~ paper -0.36 p<.05.
Model 5 (IPW, investigation): den=-0.246(se .066), causal=-0.581(se .066), causal-denial=-0.335 p<.001 ~ paper -0.25,-0.58,-0.34 p<.01 (single-trace claim).
Model 6 (survey, investigation): den=-0.26, causal=-0.42; causal-denial=-0.162, p=0.1119 ~ paper -0.16 p<.12.
All 7 bushel-trace claims (blw3kn, m638d7, g3p87v, gwlq2q, gpjxk5, mqnzyy + single-trace) reproduced within rounding.
Weights confirmed: IPW models use 'aw'; survey-weighted models use 'weight' with weights-only design (no strata/PSU), reproducing survey SEs exactly.
notes: Registry OSF id cqn7m is not a valid node (it is the download slug of the transparency trail docx); actual FLoRA reproduction node is osf.io/5vx27 (Parsons et al. 2021) and original author materials node osf.io/cmjxw. Raw .dta+do-file obtained from cmjxw 'Phase 2 Reproduction Materials'. Independent recomputation in Python (statsmodels) + R (survey) across two stacks matches all headline numbers exactly. Verdict matches human FLoRA code 'computationally reproducible'.
